paper_title: Searching for dark matter with an unequal delay interferometer
coupling_convention: upper limit for d_e, dimensionless (as plotted on y-axis)
notes: The DAMNED unequal-delay interferometer at Paris Observatory searches for oscillating scalar dark matter causing variations of alpha (d_e, ScalarPhoton) and electron mass (d_me, ScalarElectron) in the mass region [4.1e-11, 8.3e-10] eV (frequency ~10-200 kHz). Both couplings are constrained via a maximum reach approach. The results are presented only as curves in Fig. 3 (galactic DM model with rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3, and a relaxion halo model with overdensity up to 1e16). No numerical data table is provided, so specific (mass, coupling) pairs cannot be reliably extracted. The paper reports ~1 order of magnitude improvement over torsion balance for d_me at resonance in the galactic model, and up to 6 orders of magnitude improvement in the relaxion halo model. Coupling type ambiguous between ScalarPhoton (d_e) and ScalarElectron (d_me); hint favors ScalarElectron.
